messages:
mira: Heads-up: planning a lazy soup + movie afternoon tomorrow. Need recs for short, comforting films (<=90m) and a low-effort stirring/playlist. Ideas?
ajay: Short comfy films: 'The Trip to Spain' bits are silly but cozy (if you want light). 'My Winnipeg' is odd but hypnotic and ~80m. For playlists: look for 'Soft Kitchen' or 'Ambient Piano' on Spotify. :bowl_with_spoon:
tae: Add 'The Lunchbox' (not short but soft, 104m) if you can stretch a bit. Shorter: 'A Film About Coffee' (about 60m) is lovely for kitchen vibes. Playlist rec: ") + "Nils Frahm" + " / " + "Helios" + " for low-key background.
sophia: tiny rec: 'The Quiet One' (not the doc about tennis) 12? wait i'm mixing titles. hmm. OK also 'A Map for Saturday' (travel doc, ~70m). also coffeehouse jazz playlists are great: search 'supper jazz' :coffee: 
michael: I made a 45-track 'stirring-slow' list last month. Dropping the tracklist is boring but if anyone wants it i can paste. also, 'God's Own Country' is 100m but feels intimate like a long short film.
noah: playlist link (short): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/0simmer-soup (just ambient piano + soft vocals). If you want a real mood-setter, throw on 'Noveller' or 'Grouper'.
ajay: quick tip: if you want to time your soup with the film, use `sleep` and `osascript` on mac to start both at once: `osascript -e 'tell application "Spotify" to play' && sleep 2 && open /path/to/movie.mp4` :nerd_face:
librarian-bot: Added to mira's Watchlist: [The Lunchbox; A Film About Coffee; A Map for Saturday; The Trip to Spain]  link: https://internal.redwood/watchlists/mira-soup-afternoon
mira: love this. Anyone have a one-song rec for stirring? want something <4m.
sophia: 'Holocene' (Bon Iver) is a safe stirring song.
tae: 'First Breath After Coma' (Explosions in the Sky) instrumental but longer. maybe 'The Roots' - 'You Got Me' if you want a gentle groove.
michael: short picks: 'Nils Frahm - Says' (edit is ~3:45) and 'Sufjan Stevens - Mystery of Love' if you want soft vocals. :heart:
mira: ok imma try the playlist + 'A Film About Coffee'. see you folks for soup. :bowl_with_spoon::cinema:
